guide.summary: 是…的 is for a past event that both speakers already know happened. It does not report the event; it picks out one detail of it: when, where, how, who did it, or what for. 是 goes right before that detail and 的 closes the verb phrase. If the event itself is the news, use 了. If you are only filling in a detail of something already known, use 是…的.

subs.label: Stressing when, where, how
subs.focus: The event is already known (the person is here, the thing is bought); the sentence supplies its time, place or manner. Learner must put 是 right before that phrase and 的 after the verb. Classic errors: 是 in the wrong slot (我昨天是到的), no 的 (我是坐地铁来), detail placed after the verb.

subs.label: Stressing who did it or what for
subs.focus: Stress the doer (这个菜是我妈妈做的, 是谁告诉你的) or the purpose (我是来学中文的, 他是为了工作搬到上海的). The learner must place 是 before the doer or before the purpose phrase and keep the final 的. Classic errors: English-style 被 passive for 'was made by' (这个菜被我妈妈做了), dropping 的, or 是 after the doer.

subs.label: Where 的 goes when there is an object
subs.focus: Noun object: 的 right after the verb (我是在北京学的中文) or at the end (学中文的), both right, so order/rewrite items must list both as alts. Pronoun object or verb ending in 来/去: 的 last (我是昨天看见他的, 他是上个月回来的). Classic errors: 的 before the verb, 的 splitting 回来 (回的来). Never mark 的 + pronoun wrong in judge items.

subs.label: Dropping 是 (but never 的)
subs.focus: 是 is often dropped in spoken affirmatives and questions (我昨天到的, 你怎么来的?) but 的 must stay. No cloze where 是 and ∅ both work: test 的 against 了/∅ in a 是-less sentence, or use judge items. Classic errors: rejecting 我坐地铁来的, or keeping 是 and dropping 的.

subs.label: Negative: 不是…的
subs.focus: The negative is always 不是 + detail + verb + 的; 是 cannot be dropped and 没 is not used. It denies the detail, not the event. Classic errors: 我不坐飞机来的, 我没坐飞机来的, 我没是坐飞机来的, or 不 placed before the verb (我是坐飞机不来的).

subs.label: 是…的 or 了?
subs.focus: Choose between reporting a new event (了) and giving a detail of a known one (是…的). Context must force one reading: a visible object or earlier clause sets up the event, or it is clearly news. Also: no 了 inside 是…的 (我是昨天来了的). Classic error: answering when/where/how about a known event with 了.

subs.label: Asking about a known past event
subs.focus: Questions about the when/where/how/who of a known past event use 是…的 with the question word in the stressed slot: 你是怎么来的? 你是什么时候到的? 是谁做的? Yes/no forms: …的吗? and 是不是…的? Classic errors: 你怎么来了? (which means 'how come you are here?'), 你什么时候到了?, and adding 吗 to a question-word question.

subs.label: Not for future or habitual events
subs.focus: This pattern is only for events that have already happened. With 明天, 下个星期, 打算, 要 or 每天, the sentence uses plain word order with no 是…的. The learner must see the time reference and refuse 的. Classic error: 我是明天坐火车去的 for 'It's tomorrow that I'm going by train'.

rules.rule: The event is known and already over; you are saying when or where. Put 是 right before the time or place and 的 after the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 是 + time / place + Verb + 的

rules.rule: The same frame stresses how something was done: by what transport, with whom, in what way.
rules.pattern: Subject + 是 + manner (坐… / 跟… / 用… / 怎么) + Verb + 的

rules.rule: To stress the purpose of coming, going or doing something, put 是 before the purpose phrase (来/去 + verb, or 为了…).
rules.pattern: Subject + 是 + 来 / 去 + purpose + 的  or  Subject + 是 + 为了… + Verb + 的

examples.zh: 他是为了工作搬到上海的。

rules.rule: With a noun object, 的 can go right after the verb or at the end of the sentence. Both are correct; 的 before the object is very common in speech, especially in the north.
rules.pattern: Subject + 是 + detail + Verb + 的 + Object  or  Subject + 是 + detail + Verb + Object + 的

examples.py: wǒ shì zài běi jīng xué de zhōng wén

examples.py: wǒ shì zài běi jīng xué zhōng wén de

examples.py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r mǎi de piào

examples.zh: 我是上个星期看的这个电影。
examples.py: wǒ shì shàng ge xīng qī kàn de zhè ge diàn yǐng
examples.en: I saw this film last week.

rules.note: Either way 的 never goes before the verb, and the object never moves in front of 是 unless it is the topic (这个电影我是上个星期看的).

rules.rule: With a pronoun object, or when the verb ends in 来 or 去, put 的 at the very end. 的 never splits a verb from its 来/去.
rules.pattern: Subject + 是 + detail + Verb + pronoun / 来 / 去 + 的

rules.note: 的 before a pronoun (是我告诉的他) is heard in casual northern speech, but 的 at the end is the standard choice. With a place after 来/去/到, 的 at the end is also the safe choice: 他是去年来中国的.

rules.rule: In affirmative statements and questions 是 can be dropped in everyday speech. 的 cannot: it is what marks the pattern.

rules.note: Keeping 是 is never wrong, and it is usual in careful or written style. After 这 or 那 as the subject, keep it: 这是我昨天买的.

rules.rule: The negative is 不是…的. 是 must be there, and the negation is 不, not 没. It says the detail is wrong, not that nothing happened.
rules.pattern: Subject + 不是 + detail + Verb + 的

rules.note: 我没坐飞机来 (no 的) is a different, also correct sentence: a plain statement that a plane trip did not happen.

rules.rule: New event the listener does not know about: use 了. Detail of an event the listener already knows about: use 是…的.
rules.pattern: news: Subject + Verb + 了 + Object  /  detail: (Object) + 是 + detail + Verb + 的

examples.zh: 他去上海了，是坐火车去的。
examples.py: tā qù shàng hǎi le shì zuò huǒ chē qù de

rules.note: A sentence with a time word and 了 is not wrong in itself (我昨天去了北京 reports a trip). It is wrong only as the answer to 'when / how / where did that known event happen?'.

rules.rule: Do not put 了 inside 是…的. The pattern already places the event in the past.
rules.pattern: Subject + 是 + detail + Verb + 的 (no 了)

rules.rule: To ask when, where, how or who about a known past event, use 是…的 with the question word in the stressed slot. Yes/no questions add 吗 or use 是不是.
rules.pattern: Subject + 是 + 什么时候 / 在哪儿 / 怎么 / 跟谁 + Verb + 的？

examples.py: nǐ shì zěn me lái de

rules.note: 你怎么来了？ is a real sentence but means 'How come you are here?' (surprise), not 'By what means did you come?'.

rules.rule: For plans, future events and habits, use plain word order (often with 要, 会 or 打算). This 是…的 is only for events that are already over.
rules.pattern: Subject + future time + (要 / 打算) + manner / place + Verb

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān zuò huǒ chē qù
examples.en: I'm going by train tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他打算明年去中国学中文。

rules.note: There is a separate 是…的 that makes a firm statement of opinion (他是会来的, 'he will come, I assure you'). It is a different pattern and is not drilled here.

right.py: nǐ shì zěn me lái de

contrasts.why: As a way to ask 'how did you get here?' this fails: the coming is known and you want the manner. 你怎么来了 is a real sentence, but it means 'how come you are here?'.

right.py: wǒ shì zuò dì tiě lái de

contrasts.why: 是 can be dropped but 的 cannot. Without 的 the sentence is unfinished.

right.py: wǒ shì zuó tiān lái de

contrasts.why: 是…的 already places the event in the past; 了 is not added inside it.

right.py: wǒ bù shì zuò fēi jī lái de

contrasts.why: 是 may be dropped only in affirmative sentences. The negative is always 不是…的.

contrasts.wrong: 我没是在北京学的中文。

right.zh: 我不是在北京学的中文。
right.py: wǒ bù shì zài běi jīng xué de zhōng wén
right.en: It wasn't in Beijing that I learned Chinese.

contrasts.why: 是 is negated with 不 even when the event is past; 没是 does not exist.

right.py: zhè ge cài shì wǒ mā ma zuò de
right.en: This dish was made by my mum.

contrasts.why: English 'was made by' only identifies the doer of a finished thing. Chinese uses 是 + doer + verb + 的 for that, not 被.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān zuò huǒ chē qù

contrasts.why: The trip has not happened yet. 是…的 for stressing a detail only works for events that are already over.

right.py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou dào de

contrasts.why: The arrival is known and only the time is being asked, so the question takes 是…的, not 了.

right.py: tā shì shàng ge yuè huí lái de

contrasts.why: 的 cannot split a verb from its 来/去. It goes after the whole verb.

right.py: wǒ shì zuó tiān dào de
right.en: It was yesterday that I arrived.

contrasts.why: 是 stands directly in front of the detail being stressed (昨天), not in front of the verb.

cheat: Event already known, and you are giving or asking when / where / how / who / what for? Use 是…的, not 了.
是 goes right before the stressed detail; 的 goes after the verb.
Noun object: 的 before it or after it, both fine. Pronoun object or verb ending in 来/去: 的 last.
是 may drop in affirmatives and questions; 的 never drops.
Negative is always 不是…的. Never 没, never without 是.
明天, 打算, 每天 in the sentence? No 是…的.

items.zh: 我不是坐火车去的。
items.py: wǒ bù shì zuò huǒ chē qù de
items.en: I did not go by train.
items.why: 是 is negated with 不, never 没. 没是 does not exist even though the event is in the past.

items.zh: 他们是在公园见面的。
items.py: tā men shì zài gōng yuán jiàn miàn de
items.en: They met in the park.
items.why: 的 never goes before the verb. It closes the verb phrase after 见面.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān shì zuò huǒ chē qù de
items.task: Say it as a plan for tomorrow.
items.zh: 我明天坐火车去。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān zuò huǒ chē qù
items.en: I am going by train tomorrow.
items.why: Tomorrow has not happened, so 是…的 gives way to plain word order. The time word may sit before or after the subject.

items.q: 我是在上海学___中文的。
items.zh: 我是在上海学中文的。
items.py: wǒ shì zài shàng hǎi xué zhōng wén de
items.en: I studied Chinese in Shanghai.
items.why: With a noun object, 的 goes either right after the verb or at the end, never both. Here 的 is already at the end, so a second one after 学 is wrong.

items.s: 他们不是去年搬来的，是今年春天搬来的。
items.s_py: tā men bù shì qù nián bān lái de shì jīn nián chūn tiān bān lái de
items.zh: 他们不是去年搬来的，是今年春天搬来的。
items.py: tā men bù shì qù nián bān lái de shì jīn nián chūn tiān bān lái de
items.en: They did not move here last year; they moved here this spring.
items.why: This is correct. Both clauses are 是…的, one negated with 不是. The negation denies the time, not the move.

items.zh: 我昨天到的。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān dào de
items.en: I arrived yesterday.
items.why: With 是 dropped the sentence is 我昨天到的: 的 stays, and the time word may open the sentence. Without 的, 我昨天到 would be an unfinished fragment.

items.s_py: zhè jiàn yī fu shì zuó tiān mǎi de
items.zh: 这件衣服是昨天买的。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu shì zuó tiān mǎi de
items.en: This piece of clothing was bought yesterday.
items.why: This is correct. The clothing is visible, so only the time is new, and 是…的 is used instead of 了. It may look like a past sentence missing 了, but it is not.

items.zh: 我是上个星期天在超市门口遇到邻居的。
items.py: wǒ shì shàng ge xīng qī tiān zài chāo shì mén kǒu yù dào lín jū de
items.en: I ran into a neighbour at the supermarket entrance last Sunday.
items.why: 是 sits before the stressed time or place, and 的 closes the clause. If the time word moves to the front, 是 shifts to the place; it can never come after the verb.

items.s: 你是什么时候搬来的吗？
items.s_py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou bān lái de ma
items.zh: 你是什么时候搬来的？
items.py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou bān lái de
items.en: When did you move here?
items.why: A question that already has 什么时候 does not take 吗.

items.s_py: wǒ shì zuó tiān lái le de
items.zh: 我是昨天来的。
items.py: wǒ shì zuó tiān lái de
items.en: I came yesterday.
items.why: 是…的 already places the event in the past, so 了 is not added inside it.

items.src_py: wǒ zuò dì tiě lái le
items.task: Stress how I came (it is already known that I am here).
items.zh: 我是坐地铁来的。
items.py: wǒ shì zuò dì tiě lái de
items.en: I came by subway.
items.why: The arrival is known, so the manner is stressed with 是 before 坐地铁 and 的 after 来, and 了 drops out.

items.q: 他明天___坐火车去上海。
items.zh: 他明天要坐火车去上海。
items.py: tā míng tiān yào zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
items.en: He is going to Shanghai by train tomorrow.
items.why: Tomorrow is the future, so 要 is correct and there is no 的. 刚 and 已经 are for things that have happened and 过 is an experience marker.

items.s: 我是下个月打算搬家的。
items.s_py: wǒ shì xià ge yuè dǎ suàn bān jiā de
items.zh: 我下个月打算搬家。
items.py: wǒ xià ge yuè dǎ suàn bān jiā
items.en: I plan to move house next month.
items.why: A plan for next month is not a known past event. Use plain word order with 打算, no 是…的.

items.s_py: tā shì shàng ge yuè huí de lái
items.zh: 他是上个月回来的。
items.py: tā shì shàng ge yuè huí lái de
items.en: He came back last month.
items.why: 的 cannot split a verb from its 来. It goes after the whole verb 回来.

items.s: 这张桌子是我爸爸做的。
items.s_py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì wǒ bà ba zuò de
items.zh: 这张桌子是我爸爸做的。
items.py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì wǒ bà ba zuò de
items.en: My dad made this table.
items.why: This is correct. 是 + doer + verb + 的 says who made something that already exists, without any 被.

items.zh: 他打算下个月搬到新家。
items.py: tā dǎ suàn xià ge yuè bān dào xīn jiā
items.en: He plans to move to his new home next month.
items.why: A plan for next month uses 打算 and plain word order. Adding 是…的 would claim the move has already happened.

items.q: 我们是骑自行车去公园___。
items.zh: 我们是骑自行车去公园的。
items.py: wǒ men shì qí zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán de
items.en: We went to the park by bike.
items.why: The manner (骑自行车) is the stressed detail, so the sentence ends in 的 after 去公园. 着 and 过 cannot end a 是 sentence.

items.q: 这些花是在学校旁边的花店买___。
items.zh: 这些花是在学校旁边的花店买的。
items.py: zhè xiē huā shì zài xué xiào páng biān de huā diàn mǎi de
items.en: These flowers were bought at the flower shop next to the school.
items.why: The flowers are in front of us, so only the place is being told. 是 + place + 买 + 的 is the frame; 着 and 过 cannot end it.

items.q: 我们不是昨天买的票，___前天买的。
items.zh: 我们不是昨天买的票，是前天买的。
items.py: wǒ men bù shì zuó tiān mǎi de piào shì qián tiān mǎi de
items.en: We did not buy the tickets yesterday; we bought them the day before.
items.why: After denying one date, the right date is given with a positive 是…的 clause, so 是 must be there. 没 and 不 would negate again and 也 means also.

items.q: 我们是___这儿找李老师的，他在办公室吗？
items.zh: 我们是来这儿找李老师的，他在办公室吗？
items.py: wǒ men shì lái zhè r zhǎo lǐ lǎo shī de tā zài bàn gōng shì ma
items.en: We are here to see Teacher Li. Is he in his office?
items.why: Purpose is stressed with 来 + the action, and 来 is right because the speakers are already here. 去 would point away from here, 回 means going back.

items.src: 他搬到上海是因为工作。
items.src_py: tā bān dào shàng hǎi shì yīn wèi gōng zuò
items.task: Rewrite with 为了 and 是…的.
items.zh: 他是为了工作搬到上海的。
items.py: tā shì wèi le gōng zuò bān dào shàng hǎi de
items.en: He moved to Shanghai for work.
items.why: The purpose phrase 为了工作 follows 是 and 的 ends the verb phrase. 是因为 is replaced, not kept.

items.s: 我是上周在街上看见他的。
items.s_py: wǒ shì shàng zhōu zài jiē shàng kàn jiàn tā de
items.zh: 我是上周在街上看见他的。
items.py: wǒ shì shàng zhōu zài jiē shàng kàn jiàn tā de
items.en: I saw him on the street last week.
items.why: This is correct. With a pronoun object 的 goes at the very end. It may look odd because 的 usually follows the verb before a noun, but that applies only to noun objects.

items.s: 我下个星期坐火车去北京。
items.s_py: wǒ xià ge xīng qī zuò huǒ chē qù běi jīng
items.zh: 我下个星期坐火车去北京。
items.py: wǒ xià ge xīng qī zuò huǒ chē qù běi jīng
items.en: I am going to Beijing by train next week.
items.why: This is correct. Next week is future, so plain word order is right. Adding 是…的 here would be the mistake.

items.src_py: wǒ nǎi nai zuò le zhè xiē jiǎo zi
items.task: The dumplings are on the table. Stress that Grandma made them.
items.zh: 这些饺子是我奶奶做的。
items.py: zhè xiē jiǎo zi shì wǒ nǎi nai zuò de
items.en: My grandma made these dumplings.
items.why: Known dumplings become the topic and the doer gets 是. 的 sits after 做, or at the end if the object follows the verb.

items.src_py: tā zuó tiān huí jiā le
items.task: He is already home. Stress that it was yesterday.
items.zh: 他是昨天回家的。
items.py: tā shì zuó tiān huí jiā de
items.en: He came home yesterday.
items.why: Once the return is known, 是 goes before 昨天 and 的 ends the verb phrase. 了 is not kept inside 是…的.

items.src_py: tā zuò huǒ chē qù le shàng hǎi
items.task: Say he has gone to Shanghai, then add how he went with 是…的.
items.zh: 他去上海了，是坐火车去的。
items.py: tā qù shàng hǎi le shì zuò huǒ chē qù de
items.en: He has gone to Shanghai; he went by train.
items.why: The trip is reported first with 了. Once it is known, the manner follows in a 是…的 clause. The two cannot share one clause.

items.src_py: wǒ lái xué zhōng wén
items.task: Say what you came for, using 是…的.
items.zh: 我是来学中文的。
items.py: wǒ shì lái xué zhōng wén de
items.en: I came to study Chinese.
items.why: Purpose is stressed with 是 + 来 + purpose, and 的 closes the phrase. Without 的 the sentence only says what you are doing.

items.src_py: tā shì shàng ge yuè dào de
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他不是上个月到的。
items.py: tā bù shì shàng ge yuè dào de
items.en: He did not arrive last month.
items.why: Negating 是…的 replaces 是 with 不是 and keeps 的. It denies the time, not the arrival itself.

items.src_py: tā shì zuò gōng gòng qì chē lái de
items.task: Ask how he came.
items.zh: 他是怎么来的？
items.py: tā shì zěn me lái de
items.en: How did he get here?
items.why: The question word 怎么 replaces the manner in the stressed slot and 的 stays. 他怎么来了 would ask a different question.

items.zh: 你是不是坐地铁来的？
items.py: nǐ shì bù shì zuò dì tiě lái de
items.en: Did you come by subway?
items.why: The yes/no form puts 是不是 where 是 would be, before the stressed manner. 的 still closes the verb phrase, and no 吗 is needed.

items.q: 这张桌子___上个星期在网上买的。
items.zh: 这张桌子是上个星期在网上买的。
items.py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì shàng ge xīng qī zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
items.en: This table was bought online last week.
items.why: The topic 这张桌子 is followed by 是 before the time phrase, with 的 at the end. 被 needs a doer straight after it, and 把 and 给 do not fit here.

items.q: 我妹妹昨天终于买___一条裙子，是在网上用半价买的。
items.zh: 我妹妹昨天终于买了一条裙子，是在网上用半价买的。
items.py: wǒ mèi mei zuó tiān zhōng yú mǎi le yī tiáo qún zi shì zài wǎng shàng yòng bàn jià mǎi de
items.en: My younger sister finally bought a skirt yesterday; she got it online at half price.
items.why: Finally buying a skirt is the news, so 了. The how and where are then added in a second clause with 是…的. With 的 the first clause would be a modifier with no main verb.

items.q: 他们是为了让孩子上好学校才搬到这个小区___。
items.zh: 他们是为了让孩子上好学校才搬到这个小区的。
items.py: tā men shì wèi le ràng hái zi shàng hǎo xué xiào cái bān dào zhè ge xiǎo qū de
items.en: They moved to this neighbourhood so that their child could go to a good school.
items.why: The stressed detail is the purpose (为了…), so the verb phrase ends in 的. 着 and 过 do not fit after 搬到 + place in a purpose sentence.

items.q: 我爸妈是二十年前在上海的一家小饭馆认识___。
items.zh: 我爸妈是二十年前在上海的一家小饭馆认识的。
items.py: wǒ bà mā shì èr shí nián qián zài shàng hǎi de yī jiā xiǎo fàn guǎn rèn shi de
items.en: My parents met in a small restaurant in Shanghai twenty years ago.
items.why: That they know each other is a given; the story fills in when and where. 是 + time/place + 认识 + 的 is the frame, and nothing else can close it.

items.q: 这件衣服___我买的，是我姐姐送给我的。
items.zh: 这件衣服不是我买的，是我姐姐送给我的。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu bù shì wǒ mǎi de shì wǒ jiě jie sòng gěi wǒ de
items.en: I did not buy this piece of clothing; my sister gave it to me.
items.why: The negative is 不是…的, which denies who did it. 没是 does not exist, bare 不 leaves no verb 是 for 的 to pair with, and 没有 changes the meaning.

items.zh: 你是在哪儿买的票？
items.py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r mǎi de piào
items.en: Where did you buy the ticket?
items.why: 是 comes before the stressed place 在哪儿. With a noun object, 的 can sit after the verb or at the end, or the object can become the topic at the front.

items.s: 我昨天买了一件很贵的外套，是在市中心的商场买的。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn hěn guì de wài tào shì zài shì zhōng xīn de shāng chǎng mǎi de
items.zh: 我昨天买了一件很贵的外套，是在市中心的商场买的。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn hěn guì de wài tào shì zài shì zhōng xīn de shāng chǎng mǎi de
items.en: I bought a very expensive coat yesterday; I got it at a mall in the city centre.
items.why: This is correct. The first clause reports a new purchase with 了, and the second gives the known purchase's place with 是…的.

items.q: 你是___到学校的？坐车还是走路？
items.zh: 你是怎么到学校的？坐车还是走路？
items.py: nǐ shì zěn me dào xué xiào de zuò chē hái shi zǒu lù
items.en: How did you get to school? Did you ride or walk?
items.why: The follow-up asks about ways of travelling, so the question word is 怎么 (how). 为什么 would ask for the reason and 什么 and 谁 do not fit the verb 到.

items.q: 他是___上海出生的，不是北京。
items.zh: 他是在上海出生的，不是北京。
items.py: tā shì zài shàng hǎi chū shēng de bù shì běi jīng
items.en: He was born in Shanghai, not Beijing.
items.why: The place of an event is introduced by 在. 从 would mean from, and 到 and 去 are movement words that cannot mark where someone was born.

items.zh: 我爷爷是昨天回来的。
items.py: wǒ yé ye shì zuó tiān huí lái de
items.en: My grandpa came back yesterday.
items.why: 是 stands before the time detail 昨天, and 的 comes last because 回来 ends in 来. 我爷爷昨天是回来的 puts 是 in the wrong slot.

items.zh: 这把伞不是在商店买的。
items.py: zhè bǎ sǎn bù shì zài shāng diàn mǎi de
items.en: This umbrella was not bought in a shop.
items.why: 不是 goes before the denied place phrase and 的 closes the verb 买. 是 must not be dropped in a negative.

items.zh: 他们是坐飞机到上海的。
items.py: tā men shì zuò fēi jī dào shàng hǎi de
items.en: They got to Shanghai by plane.
items.why: The manner 坐飞机 is stressed, so 是 goes before it and 的 comes after 到上海. 他们坐飞机是到上海的 would stress the wrong thing.

items.q: 他回家___，是坐公共汽车回去的。
items.zh: 他回家了，是坐公共汽车回去的。
items.py: tā huí jiā le shì zuò gōng gòng qì chē huí qù de
items.en: He has gone home; he went by bus.
items.why: The first clause reports a new event, which takes 了. The second clause then gives a detail of that event with 是…的. 的 would make both clauses detail clauses and 过 gives an ever-experience.

items.src: 我们是上个星期回老家的。
items.src_py: wǒ men shì shàng ge xīng qī huí lǎo jiā de
items.task: Say we plan to go back next week.
items.zh: 我们下个星期要回老家。
items.py: wǒ men xià ge xīng qī yào huí lǎo jiā
items.en: We are going back to our hometown next week.
items.why: A plan uses 要 and plain word order; 是…的 only covers events that are already over.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le zhè jiàn wài tào
items.task: The coat is hanging right there. Say it was bought yesterday.
items.zh: 这件外套是昨天买的。
items.py: zhè jiàn wài tào shì zuó tiān mǎi de
items.en: This coat was bought yesterday.
items.why: The coat is visible, so only the time is news: 是…的 replaces 了. 这件外套昨天买了 would report the purchase itself.

items.src_py: wǒ shì zuò fēi jī lái de
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 我不是坐飞机来的。
items.py: wǒ bù shì zuò fēi jī lái de
items.en: I did not come by plane.
items.why: The negative is 不是 before the denied manner; 是 stays and 的 stays. 没 is not used and 是 cannot be dropped.

items.q: 我们是跟爷爷一起去超市___。
items.zh: 我们是跟爷爷一起去超市的。
items.py: wǒ men shì gēn yé ye yī qǐ qù chāo shì de
items.en: We went to the supermarket with Grandpa.
items.why: The trip is known; 跟爷爷一起 says with whom. After 是 + the stressed phrase, the verb phrase 去超市 must end in 的.

items.zh: 我是上个月看见他的。
items.py: wǒ shì shàng ge yuè kàn jiàn tā de
items.en: I saw him last month.
items.why: With a pronoun object, 的 goes last (看见他的). 的 right after the verb is heard in casual speech and is accepted here, but 的 last is the standard order.

items.zh: 这个蛋糕是妈妈做的。
items.py: zhè ge dàn gāo shì mā ma zuò de
items.en: Mum made this cake.
items.why: The doer is stressed: 是 + 妈妈 + 做 + 的. The cake may be fronted as the topic or follow 的 as the object, but 是 always stays before the doer.

items.zh: 我是跟朋友一起去的。
items.py: wǒ shì gēn péng you yī qǐ qù de
items.en: I went with friends.
items.why: 是 goes right before the companion phrase, and the verb 去 is closed by 的. Ending on 去 without 的 would leave the pattern unfinished.

items.zh: 我妹妹到家了，是坐出租车回来的。
items.py: wǒ mèi mei dào jiā le shì zuò chū zū chē huí lái de
items.en: My sister is home; she came back by taxi.
items.why: The first clause is news and takes 了. The second clause adds the manner with 是 + 坐出租车 + 回来 + 的. The two patterns do not mix in one clause.

items.q: 你是跟___去的医院？
items.zh: 你是跟谁去的医院？
items.py: nǐ shì gēn shéi qù de yī yuàn
items.en: Who did you go to the hospital with?
items.why: 跟 introduces a companion, so the question word must be a person, 谁. The question word sits in the stressed slot after 是.

items.zh: 是谁告诉你的？
items.py: shì shéi gào su nǐ de
items.en: Who told you?
items.why: 谁 is the stressed doer, so it follows 是 directly. 的 goes after the pronoun 你, or just after the verb in casual speech; it never comes first.

items.q: 我哥哥是三年前一个人去上海___，现在已经在那儿工作了。
items.zh: 我哥哥是三年前一个人去上海的，现在已经在那儿工作了。
items.py: wǒ gē ge shì sān nián qián yī ge rén qù shàng hǎi de xiàn zài yǐ jīng zài nà r gōng zuò le
items.en: My older brother went to Shanghai on his own three years ago, and he is already working there now.
items.why: The second clause gives the known outcome; the first fills in when and how he went. 是…的 supplies the detail and takes no 了 inside it.

items.q: 你今天怎么来___？坐地铁还是开车？
items.zh: 你今天怎么来的？坐地铁还是开车？
items.py: nǐ jīn tiān zěn me lái de zuò dì tiě hái shi kāi chē
items.en: How did you get here today? By subway or by car?
items.why: The follow-up offers ways of travelling, so the manner of a known arrival is asked, and that needs 的 even with 是 dropped. 你怎么来了 would mean 'how come you are here?'.

items.s_py: wǒ men shì zuò dì tiě bù lái de
items.zh: 我们不是坐地铁来的。
items.py: wǒ men bù shì zuò dì tiě lái de
items.en: We did not come by subway.
items.why: The negation belongs in front of 是 (不是), not on the verb. 不来 turns it into not coming at all.

items.q: 他们是搬到这个城市以后才认识___，以前根本不认识。
items.zh: 他们是搬到这个城市以后才认识的，以前根本不认识。
items.py: tā men shì bān dào zhè ge chéng shì yǐ hòu cái rèn shi de yǐ qián gēn běn bù rèn shi
items.en: They only got to know each other after moving to this city; they did not know each other before.
items.why: The time of getting to know each other is the stressed detail: 是 + time clause + 才认识 + 的. 着 and 过 do not close this pattern.

items.src_py: xiǎo wáng gào su le wǒ
items.task: Stress that it was Xiao Wang who told me.
items.zh: 是小王告诉我的。
items.py: shì xiǎo wáng gào su wǒ de
items.en: It was Xiao Wang who told me.
items.why: The doer is stressed by putting 是 before it, and 的 goes after the pronoun 我. 了 is not kept.

items.q: 你们是什么时候搬到这个小区___？
items.zh: 你们是什么时候搬到这个小区的？
items.py: nǐ men shì shén me shí hou bān dào zhè ge xiǎo qū de
items.en: When did you move to this neighbourhood?
items.why: A past event with the time asked takes 是…的, and a question word makes a final 吗 impossible. 了 does not go after 是 + question word.

items.q: 我昨天买___一件外套，是在网上买的。
items.zh: 我昨天买了一件外套，是在网上买的。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn wài tào shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
items.en: I bought a coat yesterday; I bought it online.
items.why: A counted new object means the purchase is the news, so 了 follows 买. Only the next clause, about where, uses 是…的. 过 would mean I have bought one at some time.

items.q: 这个菜___我妈妈做的。
items.zh: 这个菜是我妈妈做的。
items.py: zhè ge cài shì wǒ mā ma zuò de
items.en: My mum made this dish.
items.why: To say who made a finished thing, put 是 before the doer. 被 is not used for plain English was-made-by, and 把 and 对 do not link a doer to a dish.

items.q: 我姐姐是昨天回家___。
items.zh: 我姐姐是昨天回家的。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie shì zuó tiān huí jiā de
items.en: My older sister came home yesterday.
items.why: Her coming home is known; 昨天 is the detail, so 是 comes before it and 的 closes the verb phrase. 过 would mean having done it at some point, 着 a continuing state.

items.q: 这双鞋你在哪儿买___？
items.zh: 这双鞋你在哪儿买的？
items.py: zhè shuāng xié nǐ zài nǎ r mǎi de
items.en: Where did you buy these shoes?
items.why: The shoes are known and the question is only about the place, so 的 closes the 是-less pattern. 过 would ask where you have ever bought shoes, not where this pair came from.

items.q: 这张照片是在___拍的？看起来很漂亮。
items.zh: 这张照片是在哪儿拍的？看起来很漂亮。
items.py: zhè zhāng zhào piàn shì zài nǎ r pāi de kàn qǐ lái hěn piào liang
items.en: Where was this photo taken? It looks beautiful.
items.why: 在 must be followed by a place, so 哪儿 is the only fit. 谁 and 为什么 are not places, and 怎么 asks how, not where.

items.q: 他不___为了钱才搬到这个城市的。
items.zh: 他不是为了钱才搬到这个城市的。
items.py: tā bù shì wèi le qián cái bān dào zhè ge chéng shì de
items.en: He did not move to this city for the money.
items.why: The negative needs 是 to pair with the final 的: 不是 + purpose + verb + 的. 不有, 不在 and 不要 are different words and change the meaning.

items.src_py: wǒ zài běi jīng xué zhōng wén
items.task: Say that it was in Beijing that I learned Chinese (是…的).
items.zh: 我是在北京学的中文。
items.py: wǒ shì zài běi jīng xué de zhōng wén
items.en: I learned Chinese in Beijing.
items.why: The place gets 是, and with a noun object 的 can follow the verb or end the sentence. The object may also be fronted as the topic.

items.q: 我爸爸是坐出租车来___。
items.zh: 我爸爸是坐出租车来的。
items.py: wǒ bà ba shì zuò chū zū chē lái de
items.en: My dad came by taxi.
items.why: Dad is already here, so only the manner is news: 是 + 坐出租车 + 来 + 的. 着 and 过 do not close a 是 sentence about a past trip.

items.src_py: zhè tiáo kù zi shì wǒ mǎi de
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 这条裤子不是我买的。
items.py: zhè tiáo kù zi bù shì wǒ mǎi de
items.en: I did not buy these trousers.
items.why: 不是 goes before the denied doer and 的 stays after the verb. The negative cannot use 没.

items.src_py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r mǎi de
items.task: Say it more casually by dropping 是.
items.zh: 你在哪儿买的？
items.py: nǐ zài nǎ r mǎi de
items.en: Where did you buy it?
items.why: In questions 是 may be left out in speech, but 的 must stay. 你在哪儿买 without 的 loses the meaning of asking about a known purchase.

items.src_py: wǒ shì zuó tiān dào de
items.task: Ask the other person when they arrived.
items.zh: 你是什么时候到的？
items.py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou dào de
items.en: When did you arrive?
items.why: The question word 什么时候 replaces 昨天, directly after 是, and 的 stays. 你什么时候到了 would sound like asking when you will arrive.

items.q: 他不是昨天到___，是前天到的。
items.zh: 他不是昨天到的，是前天到的。
items.py: tā bù shì zuó tiān dào de shì qián tiān dào de
items.en: He did not arrive yesterday; he arrived the day before.
items.why: The correction denies the day, and both clauses end in 的. 过 and 着 cannot close a 是…的 clause.

items.s: 我爷爷是在上海出生的。
items.s_py: wǒ yé ye shì zài shàng hǎi chū shēng de
items.zh: 我爷爷是在上海出生的。
items.py: wǒ yé ye shì zài shàng hǎi chū shēng de
items.en: My grandpa was born in Shanghai.
items.why: This is correct. Being born is a past event that is known, and the place is the detail. English says was born, but Chinese still uses 是…的.

items.q: 这张照片是我去年___上海拍的。
items.zh: 这张照片是我去年在上海拍的。
items.py: zhè zhāng zhào piàn shì wǒ qù nián zài shàng hǎi pāi de
items.en: I took this photo in Shanghai last year.
items.why: The place where something was done is marked with 在. 从 marks a starting point, 往 a direction and 对 a target, so none of them says where a photo was taken.

items.q: 我们到家___，现在在吃饭。
items.zh: 我们到家了，现在在吃饭。
items.py: wǒ men dào jiā le xiàn zài zài chī fàn
items.en: We have got home and are eating now.
items.why: Arriving home is the new event being reported, so 了. 的 only works if the arrival is already known and a detail like time or manner is being given.

items.zh: 我们不是走路来的。
items.py: wǒ men bù shì zǒu lù lái de
items.en: We did not come on foot.
items.why: The negative is 不是 + manner + verb + 的. It denies the manner (we came some other way); 我们没走路来 would be a plain statement that no walking happened.

items.s: 他们是去年夏天在北京结婚过。
items.s_py: tā men shì qù nián xià tiān zài běi jīng jié hūn guò
items.zh: 他们是去年夏天在北京结婚的。
items.py: tā men shì qù nián xià tiān zài běi jīng jié hūn de
items.en: They got married in Beijing last summer.
items.why: The 是 sentence is closed by 的, not 过. 过 marks an experience and cannot end 是…的.

items.zh: 你是在哪家医院出生的？
items.py: nǐ shì zài nǎ jiā yī yuàn chū shēng de
items.en: Which hospital were you born in?
items.why: The question word phrase 在哪家医院 is the stressed place, so 是 is right before it. 出生 takes no object, so 的 stays at the end.

items.s_py: wǒ zuò dì tiě lái de
items.zh: 我坐地铁来的。
items.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě lái de
items.en: I came by subway.
items.why: This is correct. 是 may be dropped in a statement but 的 stays. It may look incomplete without 是, but 的 carries the pattern.

items.s_py: nǐ shì zěn me lái de
items.zh: 你是怎么来的？
items.py: nǐ shì zěn me lái de
items.en: How did you get here?
items.why: This is correct. Asking about the manner of a known arrival takes 是…的 with 怎么 in the stressed slot. It does not need 吗 or 了.

items.zh: 我昨天去超市了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù chāo shì le
items.en: I went to the supermarket yesterday.
items.why: This reports a new event, not a detail of a known one, so it takes 了 and no 是…的. The time word may sit before or after the subject.

items.q: 我是在朋友的婚礼上第一次见到他___，那时候他还不会说中文。
items.zh: 我是在朋友的婚礼上第一次见到他的，那时候他还不会说中文。
items.py: wǒ shì zài péng you de hūn lǐ shàng dì yī cì jiàn dào tā de nà shí hou tā hái bù huì shuō zhōng wén
items.en: I first met him at a friend's wedding, when he could not yet speak Chinese.
items.why: The place and occasion of a past meeting is the stressed detail, and the pronoun object 他 means 的 comes last. 着 and 过 cannot end the pattern.

items.q: 你是坐地铁来的___坐公共汽车来的？
items.zh: 你是坐地铁来的还是坐公共汽车来的？
items.py: nǐ shì zuò dì tiě lái de hái shi zuò gōng gòng qì chē lái de
items.en: Did you come by subway or by bus?
items.why: A question that offers two choices uses 还是. 或者 is for statements, and 和 and 但是 do not join two alternatives in a question.

items.src: 他们是坐火车去北京的。
items.src_py: tā men shì zuò huǒ chē qù běi jīng de
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他们不是坐火车去北京的。
items.py: tā men bù shì zuò huǒ chē qù běi jīng de
items.en: They did not go to Beijing by train.
items.why: 不是 replaces 是 and denies the manner. 的 goes after 去, or after 北京 when a place object follows.

items.zh: 你是什么时候搬到这儿的？
items.py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou bān dào zhè r de
items.en: When did you move here?
items.why: The question word 什么时候 sits right after 是 as the stressed detail, and 的 comes last after 这儿. 吗 is not added to a question-word question.

items.zh: 我们明天坐地铁去。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān zuò dì tiě qù
items.en: We are going by subway tomorrow.
items.why: Tomorrow is future, so this is plain word order with no 是 and no 的. The time word may come before or after the subject.

items.s_py: tā shì shén me shí hou dào le
items.zh: 他是什么时候到的？
items.py: tā shì shén me shí hou dào de
items.en: When did he arrive?
items.why: Asking when a known arrival happened needs 的 at the end. 了 does not go after 是 + question word.

items.q: 这张画是我女儿画___，不是老师画的。
items.zh: 这张画是我女儿画的，不是老师画的。
items.py: zhè zhāng huà shì wǒ nǚ ér huà de bù shì lǎo shī huà de
items.en: My daughter drew this picture, not the teacher.
items.why: The doer is stressed with 是 and the verb closes with 的, just like the 的 in the contrasting clause. 着 and 过 cannot close this pattern.

items.s: 这个蛋糕被我姐姐做了。
items.s_py: zhè ge dàn gāo bèi wǒ jiě jie zuò le
items.zh: 这个蛋糕是我姐姐做的。
items.py: zhè ge dàn gāo shì wǒ jiě jie zuò de
items.en: My sister made this cake.
items.why: Chinese does not use 被 to say who made something. Use 是 + doer + verb + 的.

items.s_py: zhè shì shéi pāi de
items.zh: 这是谁拍的？
items.py: zhè shì shéi pāi de
items.en: Who took this?
items.why: This is correct. 这 stays as the subject and 是 must be kept after it. 谁 is the stressed doer and 的 ends the verb phrase.

items.zh: 我不是为了赚钱来这儿的。
items.py: wǒ bù shì wèi le zhuàn qián lái zhè r de
items.en: I did not come here to make money.
items.why: 不是 goes before the denied purpose 为了赚钱, and 的 stays at the very end after 来这儿. 来的这儿 would split the verb from its place.

items.q: 这个蛋糕是___做的？很好吃，我想谢谢他。
items.zh: 这个蛋糕是谁做的？很好吃，我想谢谢他。
items.py: zhè ge dàn gāo shì shéi zuò de hěn hǎo chī wǒ xiǎng xiè xie tā
items.en: Who made this cake? It is delicious and I want to thank him.
items.why: The maker is asked about and the follow-up wants to thank a person, so 谁 goes between 是 and 做的. 怎么 would ask how it was made and 哪儿 where, neither of which fits thanking someone.

items.q: 我们是在地铁上遇见他___。
items.zh: 我们是在地铁上遇见他的。
items.py: wǒ men shì zài dì tiě shàng yù jiàn tā de
items.en: We met him on the subway.
items.why: With a pronoun object 的 goes at the very end: 遇见他的. 着 and 过 do not close a 是 sentence about a finished meeting.

items.q: 我们明年___搬到新家，现在还在找房子。
items.zh: 我们明年要搬到新家，现在还在找房子。
items.py: wǒ men míng nián yào bān dào xīn jiā xiàn zài hái zài zhǎo fáng zi
items.en: We are moving into a new home next year; we are still looking for a place now.
items.why: Next year is future, so plain 要 + verb is used. 是…的 is for events that are over. 刚 and 已经 describe the past and clash with 明年.

items.q: 桌上有一杯热茶，是谁给我倒___？
items.zh: 桌上有一杯热茶，是谁给我倒的？
items.py: zhuō shàng yǒu yī bēi rè chá shì shéi gěi wǒ dào de
items.en: There is a cup of hot tea on the table. Who poured it for me?
items.why: The cup of tea is visible, so the event is known and only the doer is asked about: 是谁…的. 着 and 过 do not close this question.

items.q: 这个字我是___手机查的。
items.zh: 这个字我是用手机查的。
items.py: zhè ge zì wǒ shì yòng shǒu jī chá de
items.en: I looked this character up on my phone.
items.why: The detail is the means, so 用 (using) fits before 手机. 在 would make the phone a place, and 跟 and 对 do not take a tool.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn jiàn le tā
items.task: Stress that it was yesterday (是…的).
items.zh: 我是昨天看见他的。
items.py: wǒ shì zuó tiān kàn jiàn tā de
items.en: I saw him yesterday.
items.why: The time becomes the stressed detail; with a pronoun object 的 goes at the very end. 了 is dropped.

items.q: 这本书___朋友送给我的。
items.zh: 这本书是朋友送给我的。
items.py: zhè běn shū shì péng you sòng gěi wǒ de
items.en: A friend gave me this book.
items.why: Stress the giver with 是 + doer + 的. 被 and 让 would need a different structure, and 由 does not combine with a giving verb here.

items.src: 我们在小区门口遇到了李老师。
items.src_py: wǒ men zài xiǎo qū mén kǒu yù dào le lǐ lǎo shī
items.task: Stress where we met Teacher Li (是…的).
items.zh: 我们是在小区门口遇到李老师的。
items.py: wǒ men shì zài xiǎo qū mén kǒu yù dào lǐ lǎo shī de
items.en: We ran into Teacher Li at the entrance of the compound.
items.why: The place gets 是 and 了 is dropped. A noun object lets 的 sit after the verb or at the end, and the object can also be fronted.

items.q: 我___是在家吃的饭，是在奶奶家吃的。
items.zh: 我不是在家吃的饭，是在奶奶家吃的。
items.py: wǒ bù shì zài jiā chī de fàn shì zài nǎi nai jiā chī de
items.en: I did not eat at home; I ate at Grandma's.
items.why: The negative of 是…的 is 不是, denying the place. 没是 is not a word, and 别 and 很 do not make sense before 是 here.

items.zh: 我们是来看奶奶的。
items.py: wǒ men shì lái kàn nǎi nai de
items.en: We came to see Grandma.
items.why: Purpose is stressed with 是 + 来 + action, and 的 closes the sentence. 我们来是看奶奶的 puts 是 in the wrong slot.

items.q: 我是昨天晚上发烧___。
items.zh: 我是昨天晚上发烧的。
items.py: wǒ shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng fā shāo de
items.en: I got a fever last night.
items.why: 是 already stresses 昨天晚上, so the verb phrase closes with 的. 了 would report the fever as news and cannot sit inside 是…的; 过 and 着 do not fit one dated event.

items.q: 这台电脑是在网上___的。
items.zh: 这台电脑是在网上买的。
items.py: zhè tái diàn nǎo shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
items.en: I bought this computer online.
items.why: The stressed detail is 在网上, so the bare verb 买 comes right before 的. 买了, 买过 and 买着 add aspect that cannot sit inside 是…的.

items.q: 妈妈是昨天下午___我去医院的。
items.zh: 妈妈是昨天下午带我去医院的。
items.py: mā ma shì zuó tiān xià wǔ dài wǒ qù yī yuàn de
items.en: Mum took me to the hospital yesterday afternoon.
items.why: The frame needs a verb meaning "take someone": 带我去医院. 被 and 把 are grammar words that cannot replace the verb, and 给我去 is not Chinese.

items.q: 我是用手机___的这个视频。
items.zh: 我是用手机拍的这个视频。
items.py: wǒ shì yòng shǒu jī pāi de zhè ge shì pín
items.en: I filmed this video with my phone.
items.why: Inside 是…的 the verb stays bare: 用手机拍的. Adding 了, 过 or 着 before 的 breaks the pattern.

items.q: 弟弟是___奶奶一起去医院的。
items.zh: 弟弟是跟奶奶一起去医院的。
items.py: dì di shì gēn nǎi nai yì qǐ qù yī yuàn de
items.en: My younger brother went to the hospital with Grandma.
items.why: 跟…一起 means "together with", which is the manner detail being stressed. 把 and 被 need a different sentence shape; 对 means "toward".

items.q: 他___上个星期感冒的，现在还没好。
items.zh: 他是上个星期感冒的，现在还没好。
items.py: tā shì shàng ge xīng qī gǎn mào de xiàn zài hái méi hǎo
items.en: He caught the cold last week, and he is still not better.
items.why: 是 goes right before the stressed time 上个星期. 在 would need a place, and 就 or 又 cannot stand in for 是 in front of a time phrase.

items.q: 我是一个人坐两个小时的火车来看病___，家人都不知道。
items.zh: 我是一个人坐两个小时的火车来看病的，家人都不知道。
items.py: wǒ shì yí ge rén zuò liǎng ge xiǎo shí de huǒ chē lái kàn bìng de jiā rén dōu bù zhī dao
items.en: I came to see a doctor alone, taking a two-hour train, and my family does not know.
items.why: Both the manner (一个人, 坐火车) and the event are known; 是 starts the stressed part and 的 closes it. 了 cannot sit inside 是…的, and 过 or 着 do not mark a past detail.

items.q: 我是去年夏天在医院认识我先生___，那时候我在那儿当护士。
items.zh: 我是去年夏天在医院认识我先生的，那时候我在那儿当护士。
items.py: wǒ shì qù nián xià tiān zài yī yuàn rèn shi wǒ xiān sheng de nà shí hou wǒ zài nà r dāng hù shì
items.en: I met my husband at the hospital last summer, when I was working there as a nurse.
items.why: The meeting with the husband is already known, so only when and where are being given: 是去年夏天在医院…的. 了 would announce a new event, and 过 would mean 'have ever met'.

items.q: 这个手机___我哥哥买的。
items.zh: 这个手机是我哥哥买的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì wǒ gē ge mǎi de
items.en: My older brother bought this phone.
items.why: To say who bought a finished thing, Chinese puts 是 before the doer. 被 gives the English passive shape, but 被我哥哥买的 is not how this is said.

items.q: 我今天是来看医生___。
items.zh: 我今天是来看医生的。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān shì lái kàn yī shēng de
items.en: I came today to see the doctor.
items.why: 是 before 来 plus a purpose is closed by 的, which presents the visit as something already happened and understood. 了 would simply report the arrival and is out of place after 是.

items.q: 他___为了给奶奶看病才搬到上海的。
items.zh: 他是为了给奶奶看病才搬到上海的。
items.py: tā shì wèi le gěi nǎi nai kàn bìng cái bān dào shàng hǎi de
items.en: He moved to Shanghai only in order to get treatment for his grandmother.
items.why: 是 stands before the purpose phrase 为了…, and 的 closes it at the end. 不, 没 and 别 would negate or forbid, which clashes with the 的 ending.

items.q: 这张照片是谁用手机拍___？
items.zh: 这张照片是谁用手机拍的？
items.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shì shuí yòng shǒu jī pāi de
items.en: Who took this photo with a phone?
items.why: The photo already exists and 谁 asks about the doer, so the question is 是谁…的. 了 would not fit 是, and 吗 cannot be added to a question that already has 谁.

items.q: 我不是来找医生的，我是来给朋友___东西的。
items.zh: 我不是来找医生的，我是来给朋友送东西的。
items.py: wǒ bú shì lái zhǎo yī shēng de wǒ shì lái gěi péng you sòng dōng xi de
items.en: I did not come to see the doctor; I came to bring something for a friend.
items.why: The purpose slot is 来 + verb phrase + 的, and that verb stays bare. 送了, 送过 and 送着 all add aspect that does not belong inside the purpose phrase.

items.q: 你是在哪儿看___病？
items.zh: 你是在哪儿看的病？
items.py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r kàn de bìng
items.en: Where did you see the doctor?
items.why: With a noun object, 的 may come right after the verb: 看的病. 了 and 着 do not belong inside 是…的, and 过 would ask about experience.

items.q: 我是在网上买___这双鞋，不是在商店。
items.zh: 我是在网上买的这双鞋，不是在商店。
items.py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de zhè shuāng xié bú shì zài shāng diàn
items.en: I bought these shoes online, not in a shop.
items.why: 的 can sit right after the verb when a noun object follows: 买的这双鞋. 了 does not belong in 是…的.

items.q: 他是昨天在网上给我发___短信。
items.zh: 他是昨天在网上给我发的短信。
items.py: tā shì zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng gěi wǒ fā de duǎn xìn
items.en: It was yesterday, online, that he sent me the message.
items.why: 的 can follow the verb directly even with a noun object. 发了短信 inside a 是…的 frame is wrong, because the pattern already fixes the past.

items.q: 他是昨天夜里一个人从医院走回___的，没有坐车。
items.zh: 他是昨天夜里一个人从医院走回去的，没有坐车。
items.py: tā shì zuó tiān yè lǐ yí ge rén cóng yī yuàn zǒu huí qù de méi yǒu zuò chē
items.en: He walked back from the hospital alone last night and did not take a car.
items.why: 走回去 is one verb unit, and 的 comes after the whole thing. 的 cannot cut 回去 in two, and 了 or 着 cannot be wedged in either.

items.q: 你在哪儿买___？这个手机真好看。
items.zh: 你在哪儿买的？这个手机真好看。
items.py: nǐ zài nǎ r mǎi de zhè ge shǒu jī zhēn hǎo kàn
items.en: Where did you buy it? This phone looks great.
items.why: Without 是, the sentence still needs 的 to mark a known purchase and ask where. 吗 cannot be added to a 哪儿 question, and 过 would ask where you have bought it before.

items.q: 这___我昨天在网上买的，用了两次就坏了。
items.zh: 这是我昨天在网上买的，用了两次就坏了。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de yòng le liǎng cì jiù huài le
items.en: I bought this online yesterday, and it broke after two uses.
items.why: After 这 or 那 as the subject, 是 stays: 这是我昨天买的. 不, 没 and 都 make no sense in this slot.

items.q: 我的手机在网上买___，比商店便宜两百块。
items.zh: 我的手机在网上买的，比商店便宜两百块。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī zài wǎng shàng mǎi de bǐ shāng diàn pián yi liǎng bǎi kuài
items.en: I bought my phone online, and it was 200 yuan cheaper than in a shop.
items.why: 是 is dropped but 的 stays, giving 在网上买的 as the known detail. 吗 turns it into a question, and 过 or 着 do not fit a single past purchase.

items.q: 这个软件___我朋友推荐给我的，不是我自己找到的。
items.zh: 这个软件是我朋友推荐给我的，不是我自己找到的。
items.py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn shì wǒ péng you tuī jiàn gěi wǒ de bú shì wǒ zì jǐ zhǎo dào de
items.en: This software was recommended to me by my friend; I did not find it myself.
items.why: 是 introduces the doer 我朋友 and is kept because 这个软件 is the subject. 没, 别 and 会 cannot take that slot.

items.q: 我___是坐飞机来的，我是坐火车来的。
items.zh: 我不是坐飞机来的，我是坐火车来的。
items.py: wǒ bú shì zuò fēi jī lái de wǒ shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
items.en: I did not come by plane; I came by train.
items.why: The negative of 是…的 is 不是…的. 没 and 没有 negate an action, not the stressed detail, and 是 cannot be dropped here.

items.q: 这部手机___是我买___，是我姐姐买的。
items.zh: 这部手机不是我买的，是我姐姐买的。
items.py: zhè bù shǒu jī bú shì wǒ mǎi de shì wǒ jiě jie mǎi de
items.en: I did not buy this phone; my older sister did.
items.why: The doer is being denied, so the frame is 不是…的. 没 is not used with 是, and 了 does not belong in the pattern.

items.q: 我不是在医院出生___，是在家里。
items.zh: 我不是在医院出生的，是在家里。
items.py: wǒ bú shì zài yī yuàn chū shēng de shì zài jiā lǐ
items.en: I was not born in a hospital; I was born at home.
items.why: Even in the negative, 的 stays at the end of 不是…的. 了 would turn the sentence into plain news and 过 or 着 do not fit.

items.q: 他___是昨天晚上头疼的，已经疼了三天了。
items.zh: 他不是昨天晚上头疼的，已经疼了三天了。
items.py: tā bú shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng tóu téng de yǐ jīng téng le sān tiān le
items.en: His headache did not start last night; it has hurt for three days.
items.why: The detail 昨天晚上 is wrong, not the headache itself, so the negative is 不是…的. 没 and 没有 would not pair with 是.

items.q: 这个视频不___我在网上下载的，是我朋友发给我的。
items.zh: 这个视频不是我在网上下载的，是我朋友发给我的。
items.py: zhè ge shì pín bú shì wǒ zài wǎng shàng xià zǎi de shì wǒ péng you fā gěi wǒ de
items.en: I did not download this video online; my friend sent it to me.
items.why: 不是 + doer/place + verb + 的 denies the detail. 不会, 不要 and 不能 are modals and would lose the past-event meaning.

items.q: 我昨天买___一个新手机。
items.zh: 我昨天买了一个新手机。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yí ge xīn shǒu jī
items.en: I bought a new phone yesterday.
items.why: A new event with a counted object is news, so 了 follows the verb. 的 cannot do that, and 买的一个新手机 is only a fragment.

items.q: 我的手机坏了，是我昨天在地铁上摔___。
items.zh: 我的手机坏了，是我昨天在地铁上摔的。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī huài le shì wǒ zuó tiān zài dì tiě shàng shuāi de
items.en: My phone is broken; I dropped it on the subway yesterday.
items.why: The breaking is known; the clause only explains when and where, so 是…的. 了 would repeat news and cannot follow 是.

items.q: 医生，我昨天头疼___，今天又发烧了。
items.zh: 医生，我昨天头疼了，今天又发烧了。
items.py: yī shēng wǒ zuó tiān tóu téng le jīn tiān yòu fā shāo le
items.en: Doctor, I had a headache yesterday and today I have a fever again.
items.why: The patient is telling the doctor something new, so 了 reports it. 的 would need a known event and a stressed detail, and 吗 makes no sense in a statement.

items.q: 这台电脑很新，___上个星期买的。
items.zh: 这台电脑很新，是上个星期买的。
items.py: zhè tái diàn nǎo hěn xīn shì shàng ge xīng qī mǎi de
items.en: This computer is very new; I bought it last week.
items.why: The computer is in front of both speakers, so only the time is new: 是上个星期买的. 了 and 过 cannot replace 是.

items.q: 我昨天在网上买___一台电脑，还买了两本书。
items.zh: 我昨天在网上买了一台电脑，还买了两本书。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi le yī tái diàn nǎo hái mǎi le liǎng běn shū
items.en: I bought a computer online yesterday, and two books as well.
items.why: A counted object (一台电脑) plus a follow-up 还买了… reports a list of new purchases, so 了 follows 买. 的 would turn 买…一台电脑 into a noun phrase and leave the sentence unfinished.

items.q: 我听说他昨天去了医院，不知道他是怎么去___。
items.zh: 我听说他昨天去了医院，不知道他是怎么去的。
items.py: wǒ tīng shuō tā zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn bù zhī dao tā shì zěn me qù de
items.en: I heard he went to the hospital yesterday; I do not know how he got there.
items.why: His trip is known; only the how is unknown, so 是怎么去的. 了 cannot follow 是怎么 in this clause.

items.q: 你是什么时候开始头疼___？
items.zh: 你是什么时候开始头疼的？
items.py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou kāi shǐ tóu téng de
items.en: When did your headache start?
items.why: The headache is known, and 什么时候 asks about its start. 是…的 is the frame. 吗 cannot join a 什么时候 question.

items.q: 你是坐地铁来的___？
items.zh: 你是坐地铁来的吗？
items.py: nǐ shì zuò dì tiě lái de ma
items.en: Did you come by subway?
items.why: Add 吗 after 的 to make a yes/no question. 什么, 哪儿 and 谁 are question words, which cannot be used in addition to a stated manner.

items.q: 这封电子邮件是谁给你___？
items.zh: 这封电子邮件是谁给你发的？
items.py: zhè fēng diàn zǐ yóu jiàn shì shuí gěi nǐ fā de
items.en: Who sent you this email?
items.why: The email exists, so you ask for the sender: 是谁给你发的. 发了, 发过 and 发着 add aspect inside a 是…的 question.

items.q: 我明天___坐地铁去医院。
items.zh: 我明天要坐地铁去医院。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yào zuò dì tiě qù yī yuàn
items.en: I am going to the hospital by subway tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 marks the future, so the sentence uses plain word order with 要 and no 是…的. 的, 了 and 过 all refer to what has already happened.

items.q: 我下个星期六___坐火车去上海，不坐飞机。
items.zh: 我下个星期六要坐火车去上海，不坐飞机。
items.py: wǒ xià ge xīng qī liù yào zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi bù zuò fēi jī
items.en: Next Saturday I will go to Shanghai by train, not by plane.
items.why: The trip has not happened, so 要 plus plain order is right. 把, 被 and 过 do not fit a plan.

items.q: 医生说我明天___去检查身体，所以今天晚上不能吃东西。
items.zh: 医生说我明天要去检查身体，所以今天晚上不能吃东西。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ míng tiān yào qù jiǎn chá shēn tǐ suǒ yǐ jīn tiān wǎn shàng bù néng chī dōng xi
items.en: The doctor said I have to go for a check-up tomorrow, so I cannot eat tonight.
items.why: 明天 sets a future reference and 所以不能吃 confirms it. 要 states the plan; 了, 过 and 着 are aspect markers for what is already done.

items.zh: 我昨天感冒的。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān gǎn mào de
items.en: I caught a cold yesterday.
items.why: 是 is dropped in speech, but 的 stays at the end. The time word may come before or after 我.

items.zh: 她是坐出租车来的。
items.py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē lái de
items.en: She came by taxi.
items.why: 是 stands right before the stressed manner 坐出租车, and 的 comes after the verb 来. 是 cannot follow 来.

items.zh: 这张照片是用手机拍的。
items.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shì yòng shǒu jī pāi de
items.en: This photo was taken with a phone.
items.why: 是 goes before the manner phrase 用手机, and 的 closes after 拍. The phrase cannot follow the verb. The object may also trail the 是…的 phrase.

items.zh: 我们是在网上认识的。
items.py: wǒ men shì zài wǎng shàng rèn shi de
items.en: We met online.
items.why: 是 comes before the place 在网上, and 的 follows 认识. 在网上 cannot go after the verb here.

items.zh: 他是上个星期从医院回来的。
items.py: tā shì shàng ge xīng qī cóng yī yuàn huí lái de
items.en: He came back from the hospital last week.
items.why: 是 stands before the time 上个星期, then the 从 phrase, then the verb 回来, with 的 at the very end. 的 cannot split 回来. The time word may also come before 是, which then stresses 从医院.

items.zh: 我是在网上买的手机。
items.py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de shǒu jī
items.en: I bought the phone online.
items.why: 的 may come right after the verb or at the end. The object can also be the topic at the front. 的 cannot go before 买.

items.zh: 她是上个星期回来的。
items.py: tā shì shàng ge xīng qī huí lái de
items.en: She came back last week.
items.why: 的 closes the verb 回来; it cannot be placed inside it. 是 comes before the time 上个星期.

items.zh: 你是怎么回家的？
items.py: nǐ shì zěn me huí jiā de
items.en: How did you get home?
items.why: The question word 怎么 takes the stressed slot after 是, and 的 ends the sentence. 怎么 cannot follow the verb.

items.zh: 你是什么时候开始咳嗽的？
items.py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou kāi shǐ ké sòu de
items.en: When did your cough start?
items.why: The question word 什么时候 goes between 是 and the verb phrase. 的 closes the sentence.

items.zh: 这个号码是谁告诉你的？
items.py: zhè ge hào mǎ shì shuí gào su nǐ de
items.en: Who gave you this number?
items.why: 是 comes before the question word 谁, and 的 ends the sentence. 号码 may be the topic in front, or follow 你 after 告诉.

items.zh: 这台电脑是在网上买的吗？
items.py: zhè tái diàn nǎo shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma
items.en: Was this computer bought online?
items.why: 是 comes before the stressed place 在网上, then the verb and 的. 吗 ends the yes/no question. 在网上 cannot follow 买.

items.zh: 我不是在家里出生的。
items.py: wǒ bú shì zài jiā lǐ chū shēng de
items.en: I was not born at home.
items.why: 不是 replaces 是 and stays before the denied detail. 没 is not used, and 不 cannot go before 出生 here.

items.zh: 这个视频不是我拍的。
items.py: zhè ge shì pín bú shì wǒ pāi de
items.en: I did not shoot this video.
items.why: 不是 + doer + verb + 的. The negation attaches to 是, not to the verb 拍. The object may also trail: 不是我拍的这个视频.

items.zh: 他不是坐飞机来的，是坐火车来的。
items.py: tā bú shì zuò fēi jī lái de shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
items.en: He did not come by plane; he came by train.
items.why: The denied detail takes 不是 and the true detail takes 是, each closed by 的. The two halves may be swapped.

items.zh: 这个药是医生给我的。
items.py: zhè ge yào shì yī shēng gěi wǒ de
items.en: The doctor gave me this medicine.
items.why: 是 comes before the doer 医生; 的 is last. 药 comes first as the thing that is already known. The object may also trail: 是医生给我的这个药.

items.zh: 我是来看医生的。
items.py: wǒ shì lái kàn yī shēng de
items.en: I came to see the doctor.
items.why: 是 before 来 stresses purpose, and 的 ends the sentence. 是 does not follow 来.

items.zh: 他是为了看病搬到北京的。
items.py: tā shì wèi le kàn bìng bān dào běi jīng de
items.en: He moved to Beijing to get medical treatment.
items.why: 是 stands before the purpose phrase 为了看病, then the verb phrase 搬到北京, then 的. 为了 cannot follow 搬到. 他搬到北京是为了看病的 is also natural.

items.zh: 我昨天买了一台新电脑。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī tái xīn diàn nǎo
items.en: I bought a new computer yesterday.
items.why: A new event with a counted object takes 了 after the verb and no 是…的. The time word may come before or after 我.

items.zh: 他打算明年坐火车去上海。
items.py: tā dǎ suàn míng nián zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
items.en: He plans to go to Shanghai by train next year.
items.why: The trip is in the future, so the order is plain: time, manner, verb. No 是…的 is used.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù yī yuàn le
items.task: Say it was yesterday that I went to the hospital (the trip is known). Use 是…的.
items.zh: 我是昨天去医院的。
items.py: wǒ shì zuó tiān qù yī yuàn de
items.en: I went to the hospital yesterday.
items.why: Once the trip is known, 是 goes before the time 昨天 and 的 closes the verb phrase. 的 may also come right after 去.

items.src_py: tā zuò chū zū chē lái le
items.task: Stress how he came with 是…的.
items.zh: 他是坐出租车来的。
items.py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē lái de
items.en: He came by taxi.
items.why: The coming is known, so 是 goes before the manner 坐出租车 and 的 after 来. 了 is removed.

items.src_py: mā ma mǎi le zhè ge shǒu jī
items.task: Stress who bought it with 是…的. Start with 这个手机.
items.zh: 这个手机是妈妈买的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì mā ma mǎi de
items.en: Mum bought this phone.
items.why: The phone is known, so 是 goes before the doer. 被 is not used for "bought by".

items.src_py: wǒ shì zuò dì tiě lái de
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 我不是坐地铁来的。
items.py: wǒ bú shì zuò dì tiě lái de
items.en: I did not come by subway.
items.why: 不是 goes before the denied detail, and 的 stays. 没 is never used with 是…的.

items.src_py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shì wǒ pāi de
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 这张照片不是我拍的。
items.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān bú shì wǒ pāi de
items.en: I did not take this photo.
items.why: 不是 replaces 是 in front of the doer and 的 stays. 没 cannot be used here.

items.src_py: nǐ shì zěn me lái de
items.task: Drop 是.
items.zh: 你怎么来的？
items.py: nǐ zěn me lái de
items.en: How did you get here?
items.why: 是 is optional in questions, but 的 must stay or the question breaks.

items.src_py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē qù de
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 她是坐出租车去的吗？
items.py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē qù de ma
items.en: Did she go by taxi?
items.why: 吗 goes after 的 to ask a yes/no question without changing the rest of the pattern.

items.src_py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de shǒu jī
items.task: Move 的 to the end of the sentence.
items.zh: 我是在网上买手机的。
items.py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi shǒu jī de
items.en: I bought the phone online.
items.why: With a noun object 的 may sit right after the verb or at the end. The object may also move to the front as a topic.

items.src_py: tā shì shàng ge yuè huí lái de
items.task: Drop 是.
items.zh: 他上个月回来的。
items.py: tā shàng ge yuè huí lái de
items.en: He came back last month.
items.why: 是 can be dropped in affirmative statements, but 的 cannot. The time word may come before or after 他.

items.src_py: mā ma zuó tiān lái le
items.task: Say it was yesterday that she came (her visit is known). Use 是…的.
items.zh: 妈妈是昨天来的。
items.py: mā ma shì zuó tiān lái de
items.en: Mum came yesterday.
items.why: Since her visit is known, the time is the point: 是昨天…的 with no 了.

items.src_py: tā qù shàng hǎi le
items.task: Say he went by train (his trip is known). Use 是…的.
items.zh: 他是坐火车去上海的。
items.py: tā shì zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi de
items.en: He went to Shanghai by train.
items.why: The trip is known, so 是 goes before the manner phrase and 的 closes the verb phrase. 了 is dropped.

items.src: 他是上个月搬到北京的。
items.src_py: tā shì shàng ge yuè bān dào běi jīng de
items.task: Say he plans to move next month.
items.zh: 他打算下个月搬到北京。
items.py: tā dǎ suàn xià ge yuè bān dào běi jīng
items.en: He plans to move to Beijing next month.
items.why: A plan is not a known past event, so 是…的 is replaced by 打算 and plain word order.

items.src_py: péng you sòng gěi wǒ zhè ge shǒu jī
items.task: Stress who gave it with 是…的. Start with 这个手机.
items.zh: 这个手机是朋友送给我的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì péng you sòng gěi wǒ de
items.en: A friend gave me this phone.
items.why: The phone is known, so the doer is stressed with 是…的. 被 is not used for "given by".

items.src_py: tā shì zuó tiān fā shāo de
items.task: Deny it: it was not yesterday.
items.zh: 他不是昨天发烧的。
items.py: tā bú shì zuó tiān fā shāo de
items.en: He did not get the fever yesterday.
items.why: 不是 goes before the denied time. 没发烧 would deny the fever itself, not the detail.

items.src_py: tā men shì zài wǎng shàng rèn shi de
items.task: Ask where they met.
items.zh: 他们是在哪儿认识的？
items.py: tā men shì zài nǎ r rèn shi de
items.en: Where did they meet?
items.why: The question word 在哪儿 takes the stressed slot and 的 stays at the end.

items.src_py: wǒ men shì shàng ge xīng qī dào de
items.task: Drop 是.
items.zh: 我们上个星期到的。
items.py: wǒ men shàng ge xīng qī dào de
items.en: We arrived last week.
items.why: 是 can disappear in a plain statement, but 的 must stay.

items.src_py: wǎn fàn shì mā ma zuò de
items.task: Ask who made dinner.
items.zh: 晚饭是谁做的？
items.py: wǎn fàn shì shuí zuò de
items.en: Who made dinner?
items.why: 谁 replaces the doer after 是 and 的 stays at the end. 吗 is not added.

items.s_py: wǒ shì zuó tiān fā shāo le de
items.zh: 我是昨天发烧的。
items.py: wǒ shì zuó tiān fā shāo de
items.en: I got a fever yesterday.
items.why: 了 never goes inside 是…的; the frame already places the event in the past.

items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī méi shì wǒ mǎi de
items.zh: 这个手机不是我买的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī bú shì wǒ mǎi de
items.en: I did not buy this phone.
items.why: 是 is always negated with 不. 没是 does not exist, in 是…的 or anywhere else.

items.s: 这个手机被我爸爸买的。
items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī bèi wǒ bà ba mǎi de
items.zh: 这个手机是我爸爸买的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì wǒ bà ba mǎi de
items.en: My dad bought this phone.
items.why: Telling who did something takes 是 + doer + verb + 的, not 被. 被 and a final 的 also never go together here.

items.s: 奶奶是昨天晚上回的来。
items.s_py: nǎi nai shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng huí de lái
items.zh: 奶奶是昨天晚上回来的。
items.py: nǎi nai shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng huí lái de
items.en: Grandma came back last night.
items.why: 的 cannot split 回来. It goes after the whole verb.

items.s_py: nǐ shì zěn me qù de ma
items.zh: 你是怎么去的？
items.py: nǐ shì zěn me qù de
items.en: How did you get there?
items.why: A question already containing a question word never takes 吗.

items.s_py: wǒ shì míng tiān zuò dì tiě qù de
items.zh: 我明天坐地铁去。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān zuò dì tiě qù
items.en: I am going by subway tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 places the trip in the future, and 是…的 is only used for events that have already happened.

items.s: 我是在网上的买这个手机。
items.s_py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng de mǎi zhè ge shǒu jī
items.zh: 我是在网上买的这个手机。
items.py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de zhè ge shǒu jī
items.en: I bought this phone online.
items.why: 的 is only used after the verb or at the end of the sentence, never before the verb.

items.s_py: wǒ bú shì zuó tiān lái le de
items.zh: 我不是昨天来的。
items.py: wǒ bú shì zuó tiān lái de
items.en: I did not come yesterday.
items.why: 了 does not belong inside 不是…的, just as it does not belong inside 是…的.

items.s: 这条短信我朋友是发的。
items.s_py: zhè tiáo duǎn xìn wǒ péng you shì fā de
items.zh: 这条短信是我朋友发的。
items.py: zhè tiáo duǎn xìn shì wǒ péng you fā de
items.en: My friend sent this text message.
items.why: 是 comes before the doer, not after it.

items.s_py: tā shì dào zuó tiān de
items.zh: 他是昨天到的。
items.py: tā shì zuó tiān dào de
items.en: He arrived yesterday.
items.why: 是 goes right before the stressed detail 昨天, and 的 closes the verb 到 after it. 是到昨天的 breaks the frame by putting 到 between 是 and 昨天.

items.s: 这是我昨天在网上买的。
items.s_py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
items.zh: 这是我昨天在网上买的。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
items.en: I bought this online yesterday.
items.why: After 这 as the subject the 是 is part of the sentence, and 的 closes the detail 我昨天在网上买.

items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn jiàn tā de
items.zh: 我昨天看见他的。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn jiàn tā de
items.en: I saw him yesterday.
items.why: 的 can go at the very end even when the object is a pronoun. The final 的 is the standard choice.

items.s_py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r mǎi de shǒu jī
items.zh: 你是在哪儿买的手机？
items.py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r mǎi de shǒu jī
items.en: Where did you buy your phone?
items.why: 的 can come right after the verb even with a noun object that follows.

items.s: 我没坐飞机来，我是坐火车来的。
items.s_py: wǒ méi zuò fēi jī lái wǒ shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
items.zh: 我没坐飞机来，我是坐火车来的。
items.py: wǒ méi zuò fēi jī lái wǒ shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
items.en: I did not come by plane; I came by train.
items.why: 没 without 的 simply denies the plane trip; then 是…的 states the true manner.

items.s: 医生说他不是昨天才发烧的，已经发烧三天了。
items.s_py: yī shēng shuō tā bú shì zuó tiān cái fā shāo de yǐ jīng fā shāo sān tiān le
items.zh: 医生说他不是昨天才发烧的，已经发烧三天了。
items.py: yī shēng shuō tā bú shì zuó tiān cái fā shāo de yǐ jīng fā shāo sān tiān le
items.en: The doctor said his fever did not start only yesterday; he has had it for three days.
items.why: 不是…的 denies the detail 昨天才, and the second clause gives the real duration.

items.s: 我是为了陪奶奶看病才来这个城市的。
items.s_py: wǒ shì wèi le péi nǎi nai kàn bìng cái lái zhè ge chéng shì de
items.zh: 我是为了陪奶奶看病才来这个城市的。
items.py: wǒ shì wèi le péi nǎi nai kàn bìng cái lái zhè ge chéng shì de
items.en: I came to this city only to go with Grandma to see the doctor.
items.why: The purpose phrase 为了… stays between 是 and the verb, and 才 can sit before the verb.

items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn
items.zh: 我昨天去了医院。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn
items.en: I went to the hospital yesterday.
items.why: This reports a new event with 了; it is correct even though 昨天 is present.
